name: inclusive-physical-education
description: Inclusive physical education for gender, ability, and developmental variation. Covers the history of women in sport from Berenson's women's basketball rules forward, adapted PE for disability and chronic illness, universal design for learning in PE, gender-equitable participation, and the ethical obligations of a PE teacher to serve every learner in the room. Use when adapting lessons for disability, designing co-educational units, addressing participation gaps, or teaching the history of inclusion as part of the PE curriculum.
